title: Coastline: Ace
description: Coastline: Definitive with a whole new take, adding more features and mods. Enjoy new tools to make Minecraft more fun.
body:
# **Coastline _Ace_** [ ](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/coastline-definitive) [ ](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XgF9kWtx4vHHc97ZJ-4f3KxiPjdav0xz5mKAegNBnS4/edit?usp=sharing) [](https://discord.gg/e5jzkAj9Ms) The ultimate modpack for _everything_, made to work seamlessly on Coastline. Coastline Ace contains everything found in Coastline Definitive, adding everything else you didn't think you needed. Gain access to powerful statistics features, a fun new customizable totem, and much more, while keeping everything from Coastline Definitive. ## Requirements This modpack is built for version **1.21.1** and runs best on the latest version of **Java**. To run, it needs a launcher like **Curseforge, Modrinth,** or **Prism.** ## FAQs
What's Coastline? Coastline is a modded SMP focused on exploration and building. We're always happy to welcome new players. To get started, join our Discord server, which is linked to this page.
How does this differ from Coastline Definitive? Coastline Ace offers several new features for experienced players, most notably Inventive Inventory, Better Stats, and JEI. Nothing is removed.
